visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair and a plaid shirt sits at a light-colored wooden desk in a bright office environment, looking down at his smartphone. A green banner at the top features a man's portrait and promotional text. (2) The man looks up toward the camera lens, speaking with animated facial expressions while gesturing with his right hand to emphasize his points. A small graphic illustration of a red car appears briefly on the screen near his chest. (3) A graphic of a white document titled VOTE appears centrally in the frame, showing checkmarks appearing in boxes sequentially. The background man is still visible but partially obscured by the overlay. Lighting remains consistent and bright indoor lighting throughout. (4) The camera remains static as the man continues his explanation, now pointing towards a graphic of a yellow taxi with a TAXI sign on top that appears to his right. He maintains direct eye contact with the camera. (5) A night-time scene of a yellow taxi car's rear end is displayed, highlighting the glowing red tail lights against the dark road environment. The visual focuses on the vehicle's visibility and specific yellow paint under artificial street lighting. (6) The video cuts to a montage of historical photographs and grainy video clips showing large crowds of people and damaged vehicles on a street. Bold yellow text indicating a year appears prominently in the center of the frame. (7) Animated flame graphics are overlaid on top of the historical riot footage to emphasize intensity. The man's face returns in the final moments, resting his chin on his hand as he delivers the concluding remarks of the educational story.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 臺灣吧 Taiwan Bar. [Slogan]: 最有畫面感的臺灣史. [Slogan]: 動畫 + 故事！練出中小學生的歷史思維. (2) [Variety]: 欸老湯. [Subtitle]: 欸老湯 為什麼臺灣計程車都是黃色？ (3) [Subtitle]: 我剛出生的時候 其實計程車 什麼顏色都有. (4) [Subtitle]: 其中紅色還反而最常見 當時應該也是 舉辦投票以後的一個結果. (5) [Subtitle]: 黃色其實 是的確有幾個好處 第一個 它很顯眼. (6) [Subtitle]: 一般人買車 通常不會選黃色 所以黃色在路上啊 確實是 統一方便辨認. (7) [Subtitle]: 甚至那個顏色本身 一看就會看到 這是計程車. (8) [Subtitle]: 還有研究顯示啊 黃色的車子 比起其他顏色 它發生事故的機率 也稍微低一些. (9) [Subtitle]: 那為什麼要統一顏色啊. (10) [Subtitle]: 其實統一顏色最大的目的 就是政府希望能方便管理. (11) [Subtitle]: 因為以前的計程車文化 跟今天喜歡跟你聊天 親和力的展現 完全不一樣. (12) [Subtitle]: 以前的計程車啊 有蠻多的治安問題發生. (13) [Subtitle]: 所以政府要管理 就要能很快在路上識別 欸這是計程車 這不是計程車. (14) [Subtitle]: 不過啊 剛剛也講了 早期的臺灣計程車 有很多治安事件 也不是說 你統一了顏色 這些事情就消失了. (15) [Logo]: 圖片來源：Reddit. [Subtitle]: 1995年 臺北計程車騷亂. (16) [Subtitle]: 兩派不同車行的計程車拿出 鐵棍啊 燃燒彈啊. (17) [Subtitle]: 連臺北縣長 都要出來介入調停. (18) [Subtitle]: 你可以感受到 以前的計程車 是一個江湖味很濃厚的地方. (19) [Subtitle]: 但隨著時間的改變 就慢慢變成今天 溫良恭儉讓的一個 運將文化.
